messages:
marco_docs: opened a tiny PR adding a console 'per-route cost + p50 latency' recipe with compact snippets. playground preview errored with a 400 on trace ingest — can someone quick-check?

helena_sdk: link?

marco_docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5127 — preview job `playground-render` shows `400 Bad Request` from /ingest/traces. snippet env var is `TRACE_TOKEN` but our examples expect `TRACE_KEY`.

ops-ryan: yep that's the usual cause. also the dashboard YAML references `billing_usd` while telemetry emits `cost_cents`. rename to `cost_cents` and add a note about dividing by 100 for UI dollars.

marco_docs: fixing both in a follow-up commit. can someone drop a tiny JS snippet for extracting `route` and `cost` from trace metadata for the inline example?

helena_sdk: quick JS one-liner: ```js
const { TraceHook } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const h = new TraceHook(process.env.TRACE_KEY);
const t = await h.latest();
console.log(`route=${t.metadata.route} latency_ms=${t.latency_ms} cost_cents=${t.metrics.cost}`);
```

marco_docs: perfect, adding that. i'll also add a very small `docs:snippets-smoke` CI job that POSTs a test trace to the sandbox ingest to catch env var/name drift.

preview-bot: Preview redeployed: https://playground.redwood.test/pr-5127-preview (expires in 24h)

ops-ryan: once CI is green i'll give the dashboard a quick render pass. sounds good — thanks for catching the mismatches!

marco_docs: thanks all, merging after green. will add a short note in the console migration guide about the `cost_cents` field name change. :rocket:
